Offscreen windows: a platform option creates message-only windows whose renderer draws into a render-target texture of the same device, format and shaders instead of a swap chain, with no DirectComposition target, Present, DWM attributes or resize presentation boost; coalesced posted paint messages replace WM_PAINT for frame demand and vsync pacing, and device recovery rebuilds the offscreen target. Measurement and pixel-gate hosts read frames back without loading the desktop compositor.
